title: Pyrenees Mountain Experience
text: Our guide, Alex, was informative and shared parts of Catalonian history throughout the tour. The size of the tour group was just nice and we had a fair bit of time to do exploration on our own.
author: syairahn2016

title: Small group. Excellent tour.
text: Small group tour. Fantastic guide.  Small beautiful towns. No large crowds. In the mountains with great sights.
author: Charles_N

title: Highly recommended tour
text:
Today we visited the Pyrenees as a family and the experience was unique!!! We were positively surprised with the entire tour, from the meeting at the Catalunya Explore starting point, the planned visits along the route, and also all the assistance from our guide Rebecca. 
We highly recommend this tour.
author: 358thiagoa

title: The trip was really...
text: The trip was really amazing.  Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and informative.  The train ride to Nuria was a nice treat.  The views were breathtaking.
author: jamie_h

title: Great tour, awesome tour...
text: Great tour, awesome tour guide Carma.  Enjoyed every minute.  The tour in Vic was great, loved this city would love to have spent half a day wandering
author: Crystal_M

title: Great way to experience the Pyrenees from Barcelona!
text: We really enjoyed this one day trip to the Pyrenees. Our guide Carmen was wonderful - enthusiastic, friendly and very knowledgeable about Barcelona and the towns/ region we visited. The itinerary was varied and included a nice mix of driving and sightseeing, group and personal time, and transportation modes including a funicular and cable car ride. Beautiful scenery. Highly recommend this trip!
author: mme22016a

title: A day in the Pyrenees
text: Wonderful tour, the guide Carmon was great, she explained everything very well and provided all the necessary support. Highly recommend!!! Thanks Carmon
author: prattvann

title: Would Love to Come Back in Winter!

We’d love to come back again in winter.
